label: 8.2h Verification and Lookups
openQuestions: VER-01/04: UAT test accounts and failing trigger not documented
VER-03: card details shape for EBT chip/keyed entry
Worldnet equivalents (customer/cards/verify, lookup, balance, accounts/verify) not authored

scenarios.title: Bank account verification
scenarios.objective: Payroc verifies POST /v1/bank-accounts/verify returns a verified boolean.
steps: POST with processingTerminalId (string) and bankAccount ach including accountType and secCode.
scenarios.expected: HTTP 200 with verified true. verified false is a valid outcome, not an error.
scenarios.testData: ACH/PAD verification test data not documented (confirm with Payroc)
scenarios.pitfalls: Fresh Idempotency-Key for corrected retries. Terminal must be bank-transfer provisioned.

scenarios.title: BIN lookup
scenarios.objective: Payroc verifies card metadata and surcharging eligibility from a BIN.
steps: POST /v1/cards/bin-lookup with card cardBin, processingTerminalId, amount and currency (no Idempotency-Key).
scenarios.expected: HTTP 200 with card type, country, debit, healthcare and surcharging when terminal configured.
scenarios.testData: Test BIN not documented; skill example uses 411111
scenarios.pitfalls: This endpoint has no merchant reference field; certifier locates the call by timestamp and terminal.

scenarios.title: EBT balance inquiry
scenarios.objective: Payroc verifies an EBT balance query returns balances.
steps: POST /v1/cards/balance with card ebtDetails.benefitCategory foodStamp or cash on an EBT sharing-group terminal.
scenarios.expected: HTTP 200 responseCode A with balances[] (amount in minor units).
scenarios.testData: EBT UAT test cards and PIN per Payroc docs (confirm with Payroc)
scenarios.pitfalls: No Idempotency-Key. Terminal not in an EBT sharing group returns 400. Card data shape per entry method not fully shown; operator used as tagField.

scenarios.title: Bank verification failure path
scenarios.objective: Payroc verifies verified false is handled by the application.
steps: Verify an account with invalid details.
scenarios.expected: HTTP 200 verified false; application prompts the customer to re-enter.
